omission.chore: Help bootstrapped startups scale workloads on AWS affordably.
omission.evidenceQuote: If you are a bootstrapped startup and need to scale on AWS but can't afford it, reply with your email and I will help you out
omission.reason: The fresh post explicitly requests help scaling on AWS affordably. Its missing steps and inputs can limit a proposed scope, but do not justify excluding this request without assessing a narrow, clearly labeled experiment.
